description: This file defines the BuzzController class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling the 'buzz' view component within the HRM web application. It extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits for authentication and employee services to prepare and render data related to the employee profile.

classes.name: BuzzController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the 'buzz' view component, retrieving employee data for authenticated users.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by adding an 'employee' property with data fetched from employee service.
